about: C2: one question per piece. `answer` and every option are verbatim values of `field` in MoMu record `record` (mockups/records.json, built from cache/ by tools/records.py). Distractors are real values of the same field from other records. `prompt` and `label` text are drafts until `draft` is false (the curator approves). Check: python3 -I mockups/tools/questions_check.py

questions.prompt: This jak was worn around 1750 to 1780. Where was it made?
These monpe, dark blue puffed trousers in ikat, come from Japan. When were they made?
Dirk Bikkembergs made these football boots partly from man-made material. What else are they made of?
